answer: Epoch-over-Epoch Behavioural Continuity. Each identity must replay a signed action history whose feature vector stays within a tight distance of its prior epochs, checked against a shared vine of timestamped commitments. Drift beyond tolerance resets the identity to zero reputation, since a fresh sybil lacks the nebula of correlated past behaviour to mimic. Honest agents seat this record on neutral terrace infrastructure, while an attacker must sustain many separate, coherent histories across every epoch, paying continuous compute and storage per identity.
